extracted.intended_audience: beginners and experienced improvisational comedians interested in the Upright Citizens Brigade (UCB) long-form style
extracted.subtask_description: A practical how-to manual teaching the Upright Citizens Brigade approach to long-form comedy improvisation, ranging from two-person scene basics to ensemble long-form structures like The Harold and The Movie.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding the 'game' of the scene
rubrics_metrics.description: Heavy emphasis on finding "the game" of the scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The manual centers on locating the scene's recurring comedic pattern or premise (the 'game') and building the scene around it; this is presented as a central principle of UCB-style two-person and ensemble work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basics of two-person scene work
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers the basics of two person scene work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction and exercises aimed at beginners to develop foundational scene skills between two performers, including how to start, sustain, and heighten a scene in pairs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensemble collaboration for long-form structures
rubrics_metrics.description: Working within an ensemble to perform long form structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on group dynamics, listening, supporting partners, and coordinating multiple performers to create coherent long-form improv pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Techniques for specific long-form formats (The Harold, The Movie)
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers complexities of long-form structures, such as "The Harold" and "The Movie."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed attention to the particular conventions and structural techniques required to perform named UCB long-form formats, with exercises to practice those formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical, exercise-driven skill development
rubrics_metrics.description: A practical "how to" book providing exercises throughout to help the reader master each new concept and technique introduced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes hands-on practice: readers are expected to use provided exercises and drills to internalize concepts rather than only reading theory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility for beginners and utility for experienced performers
rubrics_metrics.description: Written to be understood by beginners with no previous exposure to improvisational comedy, while experienced improvisors will find it useful for honing skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material is structured so that novices can follow foundational lessons, and advanced performers can use the content to clarify concepts and elevate their work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive coverage of UCB long-form comedy technique
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual is a comprehensive guide to the UCB style of long form comedy improvisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended as an overarching resource that integrates scene work, ensemble practice, and long-form structures into a coherent pedagogical approach reflecting UCB principles.
